_comment: Machine-readable locked design parameters. Updated only with evidence. 'assumed': true means the recommended default was taken while the student's answer was pending.

quantisation.expert_factors: factorised, FP16, never merged into the INT8 base

activation_numerics.npu_residual_stream: fp32, narrowed to fp16 only at GEMM operands

workload.nature: 9-frame text-to-video chunk stream; conditioned only on umT5 text embeddings precomputed offline on the host (text encoder never resident on the device)
workload.vfi_conditioning: REMOVED - no start-frame conditioning exists in this checkpoint (decided 2026-11-15)

engines.second_engine_fallback: locked: always ship the measured closed-form k_b* >= 1, even when small ([5,25]) and the gain is 1.05-1.15x; if NNAPI refuses Edge-TPU delegation (T_N >> T_G), invert roles - faster engine takes the prefix, slower takes suffix+VAE, same period equation
engines.zero_copy_route: B (file-backed MAP_SHARED mmap) validated end-to-end; route A (AHardwareBuffer) also works

rates.status: T_G solo measured (0.1618 s/block, Mali 64x64x32 tile 8x4). T_N = 0.6758 s/block MEASURED AS A SUM, not a co-run: 9/10 GEMMs from the gate-compliant cool capture (0.4178 s, npu_tn_20261115_160146) + ffn.down on the TPU as 7x FC[1536,1280] + 6x ADD (0.2580 s/block, npu_tn_20261115_174838). Still TBD: T_V, co-run T_G, per-tensor-scale parity.
rates.note: must be measured with both engines co-running, at the target resolution and thermal state; report the solo number as a kernel rate only
rates.T_N_partial_note: sum of 9/10 GEMMs at M=384 x 4 token tiles = 70.3% of block MACs, GATE-COMPLIANT cool start (TPU 29.0 C vs 29.1 C gate); superseded by T_N_s_per_block once ffn.down was measured

cut.formula: period(k_b) = max(k_b*T_G, (B-k_b)*T_N + T_V); k* = (B*T_N + T_V)/(T_N + T_G)
cut.status: TBD (blocked on T_V and the co-run T_G; T_N is now a measured sum at 0.6758 s/block, but the locked rule still requires a co-run stage rate before k_b* is solved)

gate_1_artifact.targets: int8 bytes = 1.296 GiB +/- 1 MiB; PSNR >= 28 dB, SSIM >= 0.92 vs FP32 (host simulation)

gate_2_zero_copy.evidence: docs/device/RESULTS_gate0.md (ZEROCOPY_VERIFY -> SHARED on AHB and file-mmap routes)

gate_3_thermal.targets: every timed run starts at max(SoC zone) <= ambient + 3 C

gate_4_parity.targets: per-block cosine >= 0.999 vs FP32; frame PSNR >= 28 dB, SSIM >= 0.92

gate0_measured.device: Pixel 6a (bluejay), gs101 Tensor G1, Android 17 / SDK 37, MemTotal 5.72 GB

npu.ceiling_note: M=448 -> OP_FAILED; M>=512 -> DEAD_OBJECT (HAL stops answering)

gate0_measured.implication: T_N ~ 0.53 s/block at Preset A if TPU-only; T_G unknown until a tiled Mali GEMM exists (naive is 31.6x slower than the TPU on the same GEMM)

npu_constraints.reduction_dim_note: one FULLY_CONNECTED [N=1536,K] compiles at K=1280/1536/1600/1664 (0.34-0.52 s) and fails OP_FAILED from K=1792 up (46-59 s; K=8960 also gave DEAD_OBJECT after 62 s). ffn.up - the same 13.7 MB of weights at K=1536 - compiles in 1.44 s, so the ceiling is the reduction dim, not N or weight bytes. The support query reports every one of those shapes 'supported', so it is not a viability test. Chunk to <=1664, one compilation per op (ffn.down = 7x FC[1536,1280] + 6x ADD, 2.57 s total); chunking inside a single graph does NOT work (down2 = 2x K=4480 + ADD, all ops supported, compile OP_FAILED at 47.8 s).
npu_constraints.graph_shape: one graph per (block, token-tile); whole-block graphs validated and were SUPPORTED by google-edgetpu but Compilation_finish REBOOTED THE DEVICE (2026-11-15) -> one graph per GEMM is the only viable path
npu_constraints.weight_scales: per-tensor only: TENSOR_QUANT8_SYMM_PER_CHANNEL is rejected by FULLY_CONNECTED with addOperation BAD_DATA(4), so the per-output-column scheme cannot be expressed on the NPU stage; decision pending (see docs/device/RESULTS_npu_tn.md section 2)
npu_constraints.uncompilable_shape: FC with K=8960 (ffn.down) -> OP_FAILED at 47.2 s / DEAD_OBJECT at 62.0 s, reproduced in fresh processes; it is the K>1664 ceiling, not this shape (see reduction_dim_ceiling). Both workarounds are now MEASURED: chunked 7x FC[1536,1280] + 6x ADD on the TPU = 0.2580 s/block (163.9 GOPS); Mali tiled = 0.04733 s/block (893 GOPS) -> the TPU is 5.45x slower for this GEMM. Engineering recommendation: ffn.down on Mali whichever way the cut lands; the decision is the student's

mali_int8_gemm._comment: Measured on the device 2026-11-15. Evidence: docs/device/RESULTS_gemm_mali.md + docs/device/gemm_mali_20261115_152103.json
mali_int8_gemm.dot_peak_note: dg_peak_dot 827.8 GMAC/s vs dg_peak_mac4 124.2 GMAC/s (6.7x) vs dg_peak_mad1 15.5 => arm_dot_acc is a real SDOT; the 'unknown extension' build warning is benign. Nameplate 2170 GOPS -> probe reaches 76%. Evidence: docs/device/gemm_mali_20261115_152337.json

lora_delta_ms_per_block.fused_add_note: 161.46 vs 161.82 ms: within run-to-run noise, the epilogue add is free

mali_int8_gemm.implication: GPU 4.18x FASTER per block than the measured T_N sum (0.6758 vs 0.1618 s/block) -> the paper's premise inverts on Tensor G1; T_G << T_N and k_b* lands late. Roles are not swapped (nothing refuses delegation); the closed-form cut is simply solved with the measured rates.
mali_int8_gemm.caveat: solo kernel rate. Stage rates must be co-run measured (locked rule) - T_G co-run, T_N token-tiled graph, T_V all still TBD.
